d: NASA tested out a planetary defence strategy in 2022, where it smashed the DART spacecraft into a small asteroid called Dimorphos. The plan was to alter the asteroid's orbit, as proof that crashing into celestial bodies may be a viable plan in the event of a doomsday rock heading towards Earth. Firstpost looks at the first visuals from the asteroid to come after the DART test. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the significance of the findings of the Hera mission launched by the European Space Agency, which is sending us data on the DART test.
